FANTASY SHOOTOFF SEASON 5 CHAPTER 6


Out of the darkness, the queen has emerged. She once lived on the island but now wants to control it. The queen has harnessed the power of dark magic and has a growing army. She must be stopped! Crash into Fantasy Shootoff Chapter 6 and face the queen and her forces to protect the island!




[hr][/hr]⚔️ NEW WEAPONS
Dark Sword – Heavy hitting. High damage. Powered by dark magic. Great for destroying her army.



Dark Bow – Perfect for destroying dark bots. 


NEW POTION
Arcane Juice – Restores Mana AND Health.



[hr][/hr]🗺️ MAP CHANGES

Updated Gem of Life POI - Mysterious, Strange, and powerful. Aftermath of Kron’s extraction.

Dark Knight – Strong, Ruthless, Bold warriors



Dark Queen (Boss) – The queen of dark magic. Powerful. High health.

Destroy the Queens army Quest

 Reward: XP bonus + currency (Gold,Silver,Copper)



[hr][/hr]🌀 NEW VICTORY METHOD: Dark Fire
A new win condition introduced!


Now in Hardcore Mode!

Only one fire spawns per match.

Reduced visual flickering in water.

Improved FPS in fog.

Minor lighting tune.

[hr][/hr]

notes.title: Fantasy Shootoff Season 5 Chapter 4: Overflow
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051163/e97da54c60168b9e78dcfe4412d06d283f9dbce3.png

Environmental Update: Flooded Island
The Zorb Ship’s crash site has triggered a catastrophic flood. Rivers are raging, paths are rerouted, and secret underwater caverns are now accessible for brave swimmers. Adjust your routes, gear up for aquatic combat, and be wary of submerged ambushes.


New POI: The Capshroom Camp
A mysterious new Point of Interest has sprouted atop the massive mushrooms of Fungi Forest. Climb the stalks, explore the makeshift camp above the clouds, and loot rare gear from fallen pirates. Just don’t look down.


New Weapon: Floaty Bat

 Attack Power: 119
 Strength: +30
 Movement Speed: +9
 Cold Resistance: 10

A water-resistant melee weapon with a bounce in every swing! Styled with floating rings and spongey padding, this bat is perfect for knocking skulls (and skeletons) around in the chaos of the flood.


Returning Weapons

 Baseball Bat – A classic slugger makes its comeback.
 Speaker Bat – Bash enemies with the beat! Deals bonus knockback with each rhythmic hit.



New Enemies: Pirate Skellington
They’ve risen from the depths, bones soaked and blades drawn. The Pirate Skellington crew is invading flooded zones and guarding treasure chests with eerie loyalty. Expect relentless melee attacks, cannonball traps, and ghostly grog buffs.


New Victory Achievement: Pirate Chest
Find and open the legendary Pirate Chest hidden somewhere in the flooded world to unlock the Victory Achievement.


Quality of Life Updates

 Improved underwater movement and visuals.
 Party invites are now easier to send in proximity zones.


This Chapter will be live from May 11th - July 6th!

notes.title: Fantasy Shootoff – Patch v34.6.6

New Mana Stone Skill (Mage Class)
A must-have for mana-hungry mages looking to outlast their foes in the heat of battle!

 Unlocks at Level 4
 +200 Max Mana
 +45% Mana Regeneration Rate


New Hexagon Shield
Add this stylish defense tool to your loadout and watch enemies struggle to break through.

 Plasma-infused Rare Shield – built for resistance and resilience
 Unlocks at Level 5
 +18–23 Armor
 +8–11 Lightning Resistance
 +12–16 Magic Resistance


What’s Changed?

UI Control Shortcuts:
Take control of your screen with new toggle options:

 ALT + H → Hide UI elements (Action bar, health bars, etc.)
 ALT + C → Hide Chat window
 SHIFT + \ → Hide Crosshair
 SHIFT + - (Hyphen) → Enter Spectate Mode (Observe the chaos without being part of it!)


Bug Fixes

Play Go Away

 Fixed the issue where the Select Mode widget wouldn't disappear.
 Now, pressing Play will correctly remove the widget as intended. No more stuck menus!


That’s all for now, heroes! Dive in and try out the new mana mechanics or slap on that shiny shield. More updates soon—until then, keep slinging spells and dodging blades!

Patch Notes Details:
In this update Fantasy Shootoff’s Sunny Summer event is now over, this means that the summer POI’s are no longer on the island, the limited time items like the Ice cream cone have been removed and there is only 1 trampoline left on the island. V29.20 also brings us a new update to the Main menu UI. The menu buttons are no longer on the left side of the screen but they are now on the top of your screen with a brand new look. Another new feature is the new Controller input, this gives players who don’t like or aren't good at mouse and keyboard to be able to play Fantasy Shootoff. You can use your controller by clicking Shift + Tab and the Steam in-game menu will pop up and that's where you can activate the Steam Controller, when you do this you can change your controller settings and sensitivity. Please note that if you don’t activate the Steam Controller, playing with a controller will not have all the controls and it will not work properly.

 - New skill icons

-Small in-game lighting bugs have been fixed

We are also happy to say that Trampolines have returned and can be used to get from one location to another. This update also brings us a new About page in the main menu.


Quality of Life Updates:
 - New button click sounds
 - Some Inventory scrolls removed
 - Consume potion sounds
 - Small UI color changes


Bug Fixes:
-Small in-game bugs have been fixed

notes.title: Fantasy Shootoff Patch v29.0 Season 4 Chapter 5: VIBIN
notes.content:
6/10/2024

By Operation Games

Overview:
With the G.I.U defeated, the island residents throw one big party, building a stage and a new city for guests and residents to enjoy. But the A.T is a little concerned about the meteor that crashed into the island.

New Features/Additions:
- New stage POI
- New city POI
- Meteor crash site
- 2 new weapons
- 1 weapon old weapon added
- New enemies NPCs 


Patch Notes Details:
Welcome to VIBIN, a brand new chapter bringing a new Stage POI called “BeatBurst Stage'', a City POI called “Mountain View”, Meteor crash site, 2 new weapons and an old weapon has returned. Season 4 chapter 5 brings us 2 new weapons, first the Baseball Bat and second the Boom Bat. The Baseball Bat does 121 Attack power, 41 Strength and -6% movement speed. The Boom Bat does 147 Attack power, 11 Strength and when holding it music plays. The Havoc Sword has also returned. With this new chapter also comes new enemies called Skellingtons, if you're lucky you might run into Jack. This chapter will be live from June 10th - Aug 20th.  


Practice Game Mode:
 - Sword X, Baseball Bat and Boom Bat weapons added
 - New Skellington NPCs added


Quality of Life Updates:
 - In-game gold Hud frame removed for a cleaner look
 - New loading screen

Balance Changes:
- NPC’s have a higher stun resistance


Bug Fixes:
-The in-game lighting bug has been fixed
